scope_guards: A proposed development area is not treated as an established corporation.
An establishment order is not treated as conferral of every planning function.
A land transfer proposal is not treated as completed title transfer.
CPO authority is not treated as confirmed acquisition.
A masterplan is not treated as planning permission.
A funding allocation is not treated as completed infrastructure.
Regeneration objectives are not treated as measured outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact order, functions, land, consent, delivery and monitored outcome evidence.
